newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Resources M.D. to retire.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Resources M.D. to retire.

text.p: Gold miner Australian Resources Ltd said its managing director Richard Windsor intends to retire from that position at the end of February 1997.
The board is seeking to appoint a new managing director from outside the company before that time to ensure a smooth transition of responsibilities, Australian Resources said.
It said Windsor, who has been with the group since 1987, has agreed to serve on the Board as a non-executive Dirertor.
At 10.20 a.m. (0020 GMT), Australian Resources shares were four cents lower at 70 cents.
